d: A powerful nor'easter battered the United States on Thanksgiving, unleashing heavy rain, strong winds, flooding and snowfall. Nearly 900,000 homes and businesses lost power as the storm disrupted flights and road travel, triggering over 2,200 delays and more than 400 cancellations. The severe weather also forced New York's iconic Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade to be postponed until Saturday for the first time in its 100-year history due to weather conditions. Pennsylvania, Maryland and Virginia were among the worst-hit states.
